answer: Polynomial commitment state rent requires every registered account to post a signed state proof and lock a refundable stake bond each epoch, or pay an escalating rent fee per idle slot. Maintaining 1,000 fake identities across a shared reef of servers costs an attacker >= 250,000 POA tokens in non-refundable rent every 4 epochs, while one honest agent running a single execution thread over copper links pays only 250 POA once and reclaims 100% after quorum audit. Skipping an epoch slashes 100% of the bond, though a rich cartel can still subsidize short bursts.
